name: @coldix/elections
description: Open, sourced, machine-readable Australian election candidate ledger

scripts.validate: npm run check:repo && node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/validate-coalitions.mjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run export
scripts.dev: node scripts/write-build-meta.mjs && npm run check && astro dev --root site
scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run export && node scripts/write-build-meta.mjs && astro build --root site && node scripts/rewrite-scoped-routes.mjs && node scripts/finalize-sitemap.mjs
